annotation.title_clean: 北京市自动驾驶汽车道路应用试点车辆安全检测办法(试行)
annotation.title_en: Beijing Measures for Safety Inspection of Pilot Vehicles in Autonomous Vehicle Road Application (Trial)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 北京市经济和信息化局; 北京市交通委员会; 北京市公安局公安交通管理局; 北京经济技术开发区管理委员会
named_instruments_referenced: Regulations for the Implementation of the Road Traffic Safety Law of the PRC
annotation.summary_en: Beijing's trial measures, issued October 2025, set periodic safety inspection for autonomous vehicles in road-application pilots. They combine standard motor vehicle safety checks with closed-course autonomous function testing of "three-same" vehicles, set inspection cycles and sampling ratios, require accredited testing bodies, and require filing of reports.
key_provisions_or_claims: Pilot AVs undergo motor vehicle safety checks under GB 38900-2020 (brakes, steering, lighting).
Passenger cars and buses inspected yearly within 5 years, then every 6 months; trucks within 10 years.
Closed-course autonomous function tests on 1 in 100 'three-same' vehicles every 12 months.
Tests must be done by accredited inspection bodies; reports filed with transport authorities.
Added vehicles must be 'three-same' (model, system, architecture) and pass inspections.
